claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant family for ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Fiend Spells has no activation cost, no use_count resource, and no rest reset. Spells are 'always prepared' — a permanent passive benefit with no player decision point beyond having the requisite warlock level. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which structurally requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence. A new passive family is needed that carries only a level-threshold schedule and a list of granted effects.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Fiend Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access variant for ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureEffect currently supports only GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect. Granting always-prepared spells requires a grant_spell_access effect variant. The v4 taxonomy already includes grant_spell_access as an effect atom, so no atom_widening is needed — only the surface ClassFeatureEffect union needs the new variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared — Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion (L3); Fireball, Stinking Cloud (L5); Fire Shield, Wall of Fire (L7); Geas, Insect Plague (L9)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ThresholdTiers<SpellId[]> payload for grant_spell_access
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants are gated by warlock class-level thresholds (3, 5, 7, 9), each tier adding a new batch of spell IDs. The existing ThresholdTiers<T> is parameterized over T but only used with numeric T in the current surface. A list-valued tier payload (each tier unlocking additional spell IDs rather than replacing a scalar) is a structurally distinct shape that the current ThresholdTiers encoding does not honestly capture.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Level 3: Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion; Level 5: Fireball, Stinking Cloud; Level 7: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire; Level 9: Geas, Insect Plague
